scope: GT reference inspection only, before complete F/U hidden-label review; not new behavioral thresholds

references.observation: Starts left-leading and flexed, initial recovery, right-forward lowering, middle recovery, terminal descent; no off-clip first step or final stand required.
Right (red) leg rises backward above pelvis and is held before lowering; left leg supports. Direction, side and hold must not be replaced by generic leg movement.
Punch/turn sequence includes pronounced mid-clip crouch and height change; coarse punch alone does not establish full temporal sequence.
Right kick extends and returns to standing within a 41-frame clip.
Repeated hand approach/separation then arms lower; GT pelvis/legs remain almost still.
Initial stand/sway then alternating steps and rising root/feet on nonflat support; no flat-floor contact criterion admitted.
